newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW clears rubber producer shares for trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW clears rubber producer shares for trade.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared Sanockie Zaklady Przemyslu Gumowego Stomil Sanok SA shares for public trade, the president of KPW told a news conference on Thursday.
The KPW cleared the existing 4.7 million shares and 500,000 shares that the company wants to offer in a public offering scheduled from November 4 to November 15.
Investors may subscribe for up to 20,000 shares of Stomil Sanok, which wants to be listed on the bourse's main market.
The company's main shareholders are the Polish-American Enterprise Fund and the Polish Private Equity Fund I and II, which together hold 78.7 percent of the company.
Employees and management hold the remaining 21.3 percent.
The company recorded a net profit of eight million zlotys on sales of 111.9 million zlotys last year.
